thread:
PartnerOps-bot: notification: OrbitResell partner payout file for April posted. total partner commission = $72,450. system shows partner rebate recorded as contra-revenue. please confirm treatment for month-end close.
Leah: flagged 1. this one smells like agent vs principal classification. @Priya any guidance?
Priya: quick read: if OrbitResell is reselling as an agent (we are principal), commission is an expense (sales commission) not contra-revenue. if they're a principal reselling our product, then reduction to revenue is correct. need contract and channel terms.
Marco: contract P-ORB-2024 says co-sell reseller with margin kept by partner and they invoice the customer directly. that suggests partner is principal. attaching contract excerpt: https://partners.internal/orbit/P-ORB-2024-excerpt.pdf
Sanjay: billing system created invoice-level credit to reflect partner commission because partner requested reconciliation. code snippet from payout export: ```payout_lines: [{type: "commission", amount: 72450, applied_to_invoice: "INV-2026-04-OR-900"}]```
Leah: product ops says OrbitResell took title in the channel transaction, so principal. but partner operations also recorded a service referral fee separately. mixed signals.
Priya: decision tree: 1) if partner billed customer -> partner principal -> recognize gross revenue net of partner's margin? actually if partner is principal, we booked full revenue and should record partner payout as cost of goods sold (COGS) or partner expense; contra-revenue would understate gross revenue. 2) if partner is agent -> revenue reduced by commission. We need evidence of billing flow and who has control. Marco please confirm invoice ownership.
Marco: confirmed: customer invoices show OrbitResell as invoice party for 12 deals in April (see SAP export gs://partners/exports/orbit-invoices-apr.csv). they appear as the seller.
Sanjay: operational note: billing system reversed revenue by applying negative line to our AR instance for convenience. that needs correcting. month-end is tomorrow.
Leah: urgent ask: reclass current month entries from revenue contra to partner expense and accrue any unpaid commissions. need JE and revenue schedule update. Priya can you prepare?
Priya: yes. proposed adjustments: (a) reverse contra-revenue booked for Orbit payouts: ```DR Revenue Contra - Partners 72,450
CR Accrued Partner Expense 72,450``` (b) recognize partner expense and accrual: ```DR Partner Expense 72,450
CR Accrued Partner Expense 72,450``` net effect moves amount from contra-revenue to operating expense when paid. We'll also add a memo documenting principal vs agent evidence.
Marco: good. any tax/vat implications? partner invoices include VAT in their filings; our AR was net. tax team to confirm.
Leah: please include tax ask. Also we need a revenue schedule note to show this is a post-recognition reclassification (no change to previously recognized revenue).
Sanjay: created support ticket to stop automated contra-revenue mapping for OrbitResell: BILL-3732.
Priya: posted JE to close pack: JE-2026-04-255 (temporary reversal entry). schedule CSV uploaded: gs://redwood-finance/adjustments/1925790000-orbit-reseller-reclass.csv. attached memo: gs://redwood-finance/memos/orbit-principal-evidence.pdf
Leah: I'll review JE and sign off. once signed we'll instruct AR to remove negative credits from customer statements.
PartnerOps-bot: reminder: month-end checklist item "partner reclass review" assigned to Leah at 1925790122.
Priya: noted. tagging tax: @tax-team for VAT check.
